job.title: #ACN GN - SONG - C&S - Digital Commerce Platforms - Consultant

tailoring.headline: Digital Commerce Platforms Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java & Spring
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional Digital Commerce Platforms Consultant with 5+ years of experience building, extending and supporting enterprise-grade SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong foundation in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP integrations and database performance tuning. Proven ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders, perform requirements analysis, and deliver scalable e-commerce platforms within agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: #ACN GN - SONG - C&S - Digital Commerce Platforms - Consultant
cover_en.hook: As a techno-functional consultant specializing in enterprise e-commerce, I am thrilled to apply for the Digital Commerce Platforms Consultant position at Accenture Song. With over 5 years of hands-on experience designing and delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise combined with a strong focus on business requirements and stakeholder alignment.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Acted as a primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams at Rockwell Automation, analyzing complex requirements, writing user stories, and translating them into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Digital Commerce Implementation
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and headless OCC REST APIs on SAP Commerce Cloud 2211, ensuring seamless omnichannel customer experiences and scalable platform performance.

bullets.label: System Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered complex PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms to maintain data consistency across global channels.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Optimization
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, led database query refactoring for improved transaction speed, and supported end-to-end agile delivery within international teams at Shell.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am currently serving a notice period ending on 15 December 2026, making me available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise aligns with Accenture Song's digital commerce goals.

tailoring.why_company: Accenture Song stands at the forefront of digital transformation, creating innovative digital commerce experiences for global enterprises. I am eager to bring my deep SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and techno-functional consulting background to help Accenture's clients architect, integrate, and scale cutting-edge digital platforms within complex enterprise environments.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and techno-functional consulting to deliver scalable digital commerce platforms for Accenture Song clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am a techno-functional SAP Commerce Consultant with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I've applied for the Digital Commerce Platforms Consultant role at Accenture Song and would love to connect and discuss how my expertise fits your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Digital Commerce Platforms Consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Digital Commerce Platforms Consultant position at Accenture Song.

With over 5 years of hands-on experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions, API integrations, and techno-functional consulting for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute effectively to your team.

I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
